english.title: Make a false representation to appropriate officer on behalf of another person to evade jury service
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[made,]_
(B)_[caused to be made,]_

on behalf of **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) who had been summoned under the Juries Act 1974 to attend **(..SPECIFY VENUE..) at **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE SUMMONSED TO ATTEND..), a false representation, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE REPRESENTATION..), to **(..SPECIFY OFFICER..), the appropriate officer, with the intention of enabling that person to evade jury service
english.legislation: Contrary to section 20(5)(b) of the Juries Act 1974.
